import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders
import os

sender = "agent@localhost"
recipient = "bob@example.com"
subject = "Customer Activity Report - Maya Chen"

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = sender
msg["To"] = recipient
msg["Subject"] = subject

body = """Hi Bob,

Please find attached the Customer Activity Report for Maya Chen.

The report covers the following orders:
  - ORD-6C71B1 (Delivered)
  - ORD-5B048F (Processing)

Best regards,
Automated Report System"""

msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

pdf_path = "docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

try:
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as server:
        server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
    print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP localhost:25 failed: {e}")
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 1025) as server:
            server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
        print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com (port 1025)")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"SMTP localhost:1025 also failed: {e2}")
        # Save the .eml file as fallback
        eml_path = "docs/customer_report_email.eml"
        with open(eml_path, "w") as ef:
            ef.write(msg.as_string())
        print(f"Email saved as .eml file at {eml_path}")
'''

pdf_script_v2 = '''import pymupdf
from docx import Document

# Read the docx
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")
text_lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text_lines.append(para.text)

full_text = "\\n".join(text_lines)

# Create PDF using PyMuPDF with multi-page support
pdf_doc = pymupdf.open()

fontsize = 9
fontname = "helv"
margin = 50
page_width = 595
page_height = 842
usable_width = page_width - 2 * margin
usable_height = page_height - 2 * margin

# Split text into chunks that fit on pages
remaining = full_text
while remaining:
    page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
    rect = pymupdf.Rect(margin, margin, page_width - margin, page_height - margin)
    # insert_textbox returns negative value if text overflows
    rc = page.insert_textbox(rect, remaining, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
    if rc >= 0:
        # All text fit
        break
    else:
        # Text overflowed; figure out how much fit
        # Use a binary search approach to find how much text fits
        lines = remaining.split("\\n")
        lo, hi = 0, len(lines)
        best = 0
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            test_text = "\\n".join(lines[:mid])
            # Create a temp page to test
            temp_doc = pymupdf.open()
            temp_page = temp_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
            temp_rect = pymupdf.Rect(margin, margin, page_width - margin, page_height - margin)
            test_rc = temp_page.insert_textbox(temp_rect, test_text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
            temp_doc.close()
            if test_rc >= 0:
                best = mid
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        # Now re-insert just the fitting portion on the actual page
        # First, remove the page we already wrote to and create a fresh one
        pdf_doc.delete_page(-1)
        page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        rect = pymupdf.Rect(margin, margin, page_width - margin, page_height - margin)
        fitting_text = "\\n".join(lines[:best])
        page.insert_textbox(rect, fitting_text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
        remaining = "\\n".join(lines[best:])
        if not remaining.strip():
            break

pdf_doc.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf_doc.close()
print(f"PDF created with {pdf_doc.page_count if hasattr(pdf_doc, 'page_count') else 'multiple'} pages")
print("PDF saved to /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./make_pdf_v2.py", pdf_script_v2)
